summary: Three young men in their mid-20s overdue from a Crestone Needle climb via the Ellingwood Arete; car found at the Rainbow Trail parking lot with tents nearby; Custer County SAR deployed 20 members (17 field, 3 office) after the sheriff's office was notified at 05:45; Flight For Life notified for recon, Alpine Rescue techs and Saguache County on standby; party spotted descending Brokenhand Pass at 08:30 and intercepted 20 minutes later, uninjured — had summited at 18:00 Thursday and hunkered down overnight, unfamiliar with the area and unaware of recent snow/ice on Broken Hand Pass.
location: Crestone Needle / Ellingwood Arete, Brokenhand Pass area
notes: INSERTED run 988 (County sheriff press-release statewide sweep chunk): Custer County SAR mission report dated 2011-09-28, parent-opened live.
